company.name: trexo robotics
company.shortDescription: Trexo is building one of the first wearable robotic devices designed specifically to help children with disabilities walk.
company.description:
Trexo Robotics is on a mission to redefine mobility solutions for all people. The company aims to create devices that are affordable, designed with the user in mind, and can be used at home. Fundamentally, Trexo is driven by the belief that people should have access to enabling technologies.

Currently, Trexo is building a device designed specifically for children with disabilities.

productsAndServices.description: A wearable robotic walking system configured for individual children with disabilities to support over-ground walking, gait training, weight bearing, strengthening, and movement at home.
productsAndServices.name: Trexo Home

productsAndServices.description: A robotic walking system for physical therapists that supports mobility solutions, gait training, and over-ground walking in clinics, hospitals, and rehabilitation facilities.
